title: K Closest Points to Origin

story.title: The Nearest Campfires
story.text: Scouts report campfires on a map. A ranger keeps a pyramid of the k nearest so far with the farthest of them on top, ready to be swapped out for anything closer.
story.goal: Return the k points closest to (0, 0), in any order.

layers.label: k nearest [dist², index], farthest on top
